title.zh: 请升级至 v0.7.20（静默安装受阻时请手动覆盖）
title.en: Please update to v0.7.20 (install manually if silent update stalls)

body.zh: v0.7.19（含开发版 v0.7.19-dev.1）存在静默自更新超时失败、Shizuku 误报未授权及设置页偶发 502 等问题，已在 v0.7.20 / v0.7.20-dev.1 修复。从旧版更新时建议直接下载新版 APK 手动覆盖安装，或硬等静默安装超时后在自动弹出的系统安装器中手动点击安装（数据与会话完整保留）。
body.en: v0.7.19 (including v0.7.19-dev.1) has regressions causing silent self-update timeouts, false Shizuku unauthorized status, and occasional HTTP 502 errors in Settings, fixed in v0.7.20 / v0.7.20-dev.1. To update from an affected build, please download the new APK and overwrite-install manually, or wait out the silent-install timeout and tap Install in the system prompt (all data and sessions are preserved).
